assessment.nobel_worthiness: Her dream-logic fiction is one of the most uncompromising voices in modern Chinese prose. It dissolves ordinary psychology, space and causality, and public knowledge suggests a sustained project over several decades, including short fiction, novels and critical writing. The formal rigor and the imaginative and intellectual depth are high under common criteria. The idiom is her own and not easily reduced to any inherited school.
assessment.attribution: A citation would credit one writer for a body of radically estranged narrative that renews the possibilities of fiction in Chinese. Scope should rest on the whole oeuvre, with Frontier and Love in the New Millennium as representative rather than defining works.
assessment.maturity: A long career with consistent aesthetic commitment and continued output. Her formal approach has changed little in direction while still developing, which suggests durability.
uncertainties: Her prose is mostly read in translation, and I cannot independently judge how much of the sentence-level strangeness survives.
The English-language corpus is only a selection of her work; I have not verified coverage.
Her work is sometimes read as allegory, and the committee would need to confirm that the case rests on literary invention rather than interpretive projection.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: She is highly distinctive in recasting classical scholarship, lyric, essay, verse novel and visual book form. Autobiography of Red and Nox show formal invention joined to emotional and intellectual force. Her translations and essays on Greek texts extend that range. The scholarly and lyric registers are held together with real originality.
assessment.attribution: A citation would name one writer for hybrid forms that open the boundaries of poetry, essay and narrative. The scope would need to cover her translations and performance-oriented work in a balanced way.
assessment.maturity: The output has been consistent over several decades and shows continued formal change. Her influence on contemporary English-language poetry is wide, though whether that places her within the Nobel's idealist framework is a matter for debate.
uncertainties: Her reputation partly rests on genre-crossing works whose literary status may be weighed differently by different readers.
Some of her most striking effects depend on book design and layout, which may not survive in other formats or in translation.
Her translations and classical scholarship may be weighed differently from original work.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The densely patterned, visionary prose of Blinding and Solenoid builds a metaphysical project out of memory, body and city. Cărtărescu also writes poetry and essays. The imaginative ambition and architectural scale are exceptional, and the Romanian-language prose has a recognizable and singular identity.
assessment.attribution: A citation would credit one writer for an expansive literary cosmos grounded in Bucharest and extended into metaphysical fiction. The scope should include his poetry as well as the major prose works.
assessment.maturity: A long and ambitious career, with the large prose works appearing from the 1990s onward. The later books appear to confirm rather than dilute the achievement.
uncertainties: The size and density of the major novels make the translated corpus uneven, and coverage of the poetry in translation is limited.
The strength of the translations is difficult for me to assess independently.
The risk of repetition across very large books may deserve scrutiny.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Carpentaria and The Swan Book remake the novel through Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time. The polyphonic structures and the scale of Carpentaria give her a distinct place in English-language fiction. Her nonfiction, including the collective memoir Tracker, widens the range. Linguistic achievement and imaginative depth are both strong.
assessment.attribution: A citation would name one writer for large-scale narrative that carries Aboriginal storytelling and political imagination into the novel form. Her collaborative nonfiction should be treated carefully so that the credit stays with the writer.
assessment.maturity: The body of work is smaller than that of some candidates, but it is substantial and has shown real growth. Later work is available to extend the case.
uncertainties: The number of major works is modest compared with other candidates, which bears on sustained quality.
I cannot verify the reception of her most recent novel from the supplied material.
Care is needed that political significance is not substituted for literary merit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: He is a major figure in the renewal of modern Arabic poetry, working through myth, fragmentation and sustained dialogue with the classical tradition. The poetic and critical project has a clear historical significance for Arabic literary language. The achievement is formal and linguistic in an important sense.
assessment.attribution: A citation would credit one poet for remaking the language and forms of Arabic verse, with his essays and anthologizing as context for the poetry rather than the basis for the award.
assessment.maturity: A very long career with a consistent aesthetic position. His historical importance is well established in public discussion, and the question is mainly whether the work is still seen as vital.
uncertainties: Poetry in Arabic is hard to judge in translation, and the available English and French renderings may not capture the prosody.
His public and political statements are controversial, and these should not be allowed to stand in for a literary assessment.
I cannot independently verify the corpus coverage in Swedish translation.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Compressed, intensely worked prose turns obscure lives and art history into narrative inquiry, as in Small Lives and The Eleven. The sentence-level craft is among the most concentrated in contemporary French writing. Depth is high even though the output is small.
assessment.attribution: A citation would credit one writer for a distinctive prose of imaginative biography and historical reflection. It would be a case about quality and compression and not about volume.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre has been built slowly since the 1980s and appears consistent. The small number of books is a limitation on the sustained-quality criterion, though not on its intensity.
uncertainties: The prose is highly dependent on French syntax and rhythm, so translation loses a great deal.
The small corpus raises the question of whether it is broad enough for the scope of the prize.
Translation coverage in English and Swedish is uneven.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: His large poetic sequences, such as Purgatory and Anteparadise, turn suffering and political catastrophe into a collective memorial form. The projects that move poetry into landscape scale, including the sky-writing and desert works, extend the idea of what a poem can be. The ambition and the formal range are considerable.
assessment.attribution: A citation would credit one poet for a body of work that joins personal and collective memory in a distinctive poetic language. Scope should centre on the poetry and treat the landscape pieces as part of the poetic practice.
assessment.maturity: A career of several decades with a coherent project. The later work extends the earlier themes, which supports durability, though it also raises the question of repetition.
uncertainties: Poetry in Spanish is difficult to assess in translation, and some of the visual and landscape elements cannot be experienced on the page.
The historical context of dictatorship gives the work much of its force, and it should be separated from literary merit.
Translation coverage in Swedish and English is partial.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: She writes in both Japanese and German and turns linguistic estrangement into inventive narrative, poetic and dramatic form. The Emissary and Memoirs of a Polar Bear show a playful but exacting formal intelligence. Writing across two languages is itself a distinctive aspect of the achievement.
assessment.attribution: A citation would credit one writer for work that makes the experience of moving between languages a literary method. The scope should say clearly that the oeuvre belongs to two literatures.
assessment.maturity: A long career across fiction, poetry, essays and drama, with recent work still developing. The case is strong but may not yet be as established as the others on this ballot.
uncertainties: Because she writes in two languages, the committee needs readers competent in both to judge the whole body of work.
Much of what I know comes through translation, and the translation of wordplay is particularly uncertain.
Her work is sometimes read mainly through the migration and identity theme, which may be narrower than the real range.
